newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - PSBank rated a long-term buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - PSBank rated a long-term buy.

text.p: Angping Securities said on Tuesday it had downgraded its recommendation on Philippine Savings Bank (PSBank) to a "long-term buy" from "buy".

Analyst Audi Pantillano said the increasing size of PSBank's loan portfolio on which repayments were delayed by clients as well as the higher cost of funds could affect the bank's bottomline this year.
Pantillano said the bank's overdue loans had risen during the year, to 5.0 to 7.0 percent of total loans against 3.0 to 5.0 percent last year.
PSBank was forced to raise interest rates to stay competitive, he said.
"We estimate that increasing cost of deposits will have a significant impact on this year's net interest margins which have averaged at 7.3 percent in recent years."
PSBank made a net profit of 300 million pesos in the first eight months of this year and its target for the full year is 500 million pesos.
Pantillano said the sale of its foreclosed assets could boost PSBank's net income.
"We are still confident in PSBank's ability to withstand competition as it remains entrenched in consumer financing business," Pantillano added.
